name: Resource family with an unmodeled service resource context fails closed
note: IAM-1201: the attached-resource context parses to a valid ARN, but for a service whose resource-policy shape this analyzer does not yet model (a Lambda function). This tranche models S3, SNS, SQS, and KMS key policies only; anything else fails closed with UNSUPPORTED_RESOURCE_SHAPE rather than apply S3/KMS reasoning to an unmodeled service - unsupported does NOT mean safe.
